title: Concept: AWS access key id in source
description: An AWS access key id names a principal and pairs with a secret to sign every request, so committing one exposes a durable credential that survives cleanup. The rule reports the shape; validity and scope must be confirmed by the owner.
applicability: Any source file that may contain configuration or fixtures.
risk: Unauthorised AWS API use with the key's permissions; MEDIUM severity until validity is confirmed.
